The value area, already wearing out all week, finally gave way. There's a bearish 15m FVG right at the edge of the pullback cluster (7832.50-7833.50) that could act as immediate resistance to any bounce. The underlying frame (daily/weekly +3/+3) still hasn't formally broken -- the real invalidation (7670.25) is far away -- but the session structure (CHoCH dn) is the first real technical crack in 5 days. During the reopen price got trapped between 7829.00 and 7834.00, right at the edge of the 7832.50-7836.75 cluster (EMA20) and the no-trade zone -- it confirmed neither the reclaim (no close above 7836.75) nor the breakdown (no close below 7827.75), the frame conflict is still unresolved.

GC.es: El día más violento medido: nuevo mínimo de ciclo y luego un máximo a 9 pts de invalidar el reinicio bajista. Mañana es el verdadero punto de decisión -- sostiene bajo 4396.6-4408.5 (revive el corto) o cierra sobre 4423.30 (revive el largo de 3 días del 09-18). Sesgo NEUTRAL por honestidad hasta ver la resolución.
GC.en: The most violent day measured: a fresh cycle low and then a high just 9 pts from invalidating the bearish restart. Tomorrow is the real decision point -- it holds below 4396.6-4408.5 (revives the short) or closes above 4423.30 (revives the 09-18 3-day long). NEUTRAL bias out of honesty until the resolution shows up.

YM.es: Rompió su 4a tesis de 1 día en 2 semanas, la más violenta -- pero esta vez arranca con los 4 marcos crudos alineados bajistas, sin el conflicto que traían las 3 anteriores. El H/L probablemente se forma en el rechazo (o pérdida) del FVG de 1h 52263-52379. Respetar R-YM-tesis-de-un-dia igual: no perseguir sin ver el rechazo.
YM.en: Broke its 4th one-day thesis in 2 weeks, the most violent one -- but this time it starts with all 4 raw frames aligned bearish, without the conflict the previous 3 carried. The day's H/L will likely form on the rejection (or loss) of the 1h FVG 52263-52379. Still respect R-YM-tesis-de-un-dia: don't chase without seeing the rejection.

CL.es: Reinicio bajista confirmado por 3a sesión pese al round-trip más violento del bus. Esta noche es de GESTIÓN, no de extensión: el catalizador real es el inventario EIA de MAÑANA miércoles 09:30 CT (sesión de NY). Hasta entonces, tratar cualquier rebote hacia 90.19-90.80 como venta de gestión salvo reclamo con cierre 5m sostenido.
CL.en: Bearish restart confirmed for a 3rd session despite the bus's most violent round-trip. Tonight is MANAGEMENT, not extension: the real catalyst is tomorrow's Wednesday 09:30 CT EIA inventory report (NY session). Until then, treat any bounce toward 90.19-90.80 as management selling unless there's a reclaim with a sustained 5m close.
